question: There are four different elements along with their atomic numbers: A (9), B (11), C (19) and D (37). Find the odd element from these with respect to their positions in the periodic table?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Element A (9)** corresponds to Fluorine, which is a halogen located in Group 17 of the periodic table.
 
• **Element B (11)** corresponds to Sodium, which is an alkali metal located in Group 1 of the periodic table.
